title: Rotation Point

story.briefing: Before the rotated array can be repaired, the exact point where it wraps has to be found — the smallest value, wherever it has ended up.
story.success: Rotation point found. The array can be unwound.

description: A non-empty array of distinct values was sorted in increasing order and then rotated left by an unknown amount, possibly zero. Return the smallest value in it.
hints: Comparing the middle element against the last element tells you which side of the wrap point you are standing on.
Comparing the middle against the *first* element instead breaks on an unrotated array. Choosing the right anchor is the whole trick.

While lo is below hi: if the middle value is greater than the value at hi, the smallest must be to the right, so set lo to mid plus 1; otherwise set hi to mid. When they meet, that position holds the answer.
